requirements.statement: Report account and project hold register/source disagreement without releasing or repairing rows.
Report project holds more than one sweep interval behind their deadline and eligible check, using the persisted clock floor without advancing it.
Report a faulted writer service before stopping it through D13; preserve successor settlement and report stop failures.
Report SH-7 custody/context, byte-budget and publication-material disagreement; healthy stores remain quiet.
Bound read-only source reads using keyset pages, existing indexes and deadlines; continue past page limits without a lifetime refusal.
Use project-scoped findings with fixed plain owner wording and no private content; register the holds check in the monitor.
